I wrote the LRU cache in `main.wj`. The first example gives the expected output under `wj run --interpret`, and `wj build main.wj` compiled it successfully.

I didn't run the second example or any other inputs. The cache is two parallel lists with the most recently used key first, so each command scans up to 50 entries.

The interpreter printed warnings about `.clone()` and `println` format string
